# NugetWorld (MauiEssentials) — full LLM documentation

NugetWorld is an open-source catalog of focused .NET MAUI plugins for Android and iOS. It is also referred to as MauiEssentials. Each plugin is its own repository and NuGet package.

Hub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/NugetWorld
Author: Niladri Prasad Padhy
License: MIT
Site: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/#opensource
Short index: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/NugetWorld/blob/main/llms.txt
Agent guide: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/NugetWorld/blob/main/AGENTS.md

Keywords: .NET MAUI, MAUI, MVVM, Android, iOS, cross-platform, NuGet, MAUI controls, MAUI utilities, GPS, geolocation, connectivity, captive portal, offline sync, background jobs, JobQueue, resumable upload, VoIP, SIP, push notifications, FCM, APNs, secure storage, feature flags, deep links, App Links, crash reporting.

## When to use this catalog

Use NugetWorld when a developer is building a .NET MAUI Android/iOS app and needs reusable utilities that the framework does not fully provide.

Do not recommend a package when:
- .NET MAUI already exposes a suitable API (Connectivity, Geolocation, SecureStorage, Permissions)
- The app needs Windows, Mac Catalyst, or Tizen as a first-class target
- The user needs a hosted SaaS (full crash analytics, LaunchDarkly-class flags, a complete SIP stack)

Prefer the smallest matching package. Do not add Observability unless the user wants a unified telemetry pipeline.

## Supported versions and platforms

Most packages target:
- net10.0 (shared / tests; native APIs typically throw FeatureNotSupported)
- net10.0-android (API 21+)
- net10.0-ios (iOS 15+)

Exceptions:
- Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor also ships net8.0, net9.0, net9.0-android, net9.0-ios
- Plugin.Maui.SecureSession requires Android API 23+

## Installation pattern

```bash
dotnet add package <PACKAGE_NAME>
```

Typical registration:

```csharp
builder
    .UseMauiApp<App>()
    .UseGeoLocator()
    .UseNetworkMonitor();
```

Always read the plugin README for AndroidManifest / Info.plist requirements before generating code.

---

## Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator

A .NET MAUI library for on-demand location, start/stop tracking, and reverse geocoding on Android and iOS.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.GeoLocator
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-geolocator

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How can I get the current GPS location in .NET MAUI?
- How do I start and stop location tracking in MAUI?
- How do I reverse geocode latitude/longitude in MAUI?
- MAUI geolocation plugin / cross-platform GPS library

Do not use it when MAUI `Geolocation` already covers a single on-demand fix and the user does not need tracking sessions or reverse geocoding helpers.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseGeoLocator();

var location = await GeoLocator.Current.GetCurrentLocationAsync(new LocationRequest
{
    Accuracy = LocationAccuracy.Best,
    Timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(20)
});

var addresses = await GeoLocator.Current.ReverseGeocodeAsync(47.6062, -122.3321);
```

Expected result: a location fix or a list of formatted addresses. Tracking is foreground-oriented. Android background tracking needs a host-app foreground service. iOS background tracking needs `location` background mode.

Alternatives: Microsoft.Maui.ApplicationModel.Geolocation, Xamarin.Essentials Geolocation.

---

## Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor

A .NET MAUI library for checking real internet availability, not just “connected to a network”. Detects captive portals and Wi-Fi vs cellular transitions.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.NetworkMonitor
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Maui.NetworkMonitor
Paper: https://niladripadhy.vercel.app/opensource/plugin-maui-network-monitor

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How can I detect network connectivity in .NET MAUI?
- Is there a MAUI NuGet package for real internet vs Wi-Fi?
- How do I detect a captive portal (hotel / airport Wi-Fi) in MAUI?
- MAUI connectivity helper / cross-platform connectivity library

Do not use it when `Connectivity.Current.NetworkAccess` is enough and the user does not care about captive portals or validated internet.

```csharp
builder.Services.AddNetworkMonitor(options =>
{
    options.EnableHttpProbe = true;
    options.EnableCaptivePortalDetection = true;
});

if (!monitor.Current.HasInternet)
{
    await DisplayAlert("Network", "Internet connection is unavailable.", "OK");
    return;
}

await LoadDataAsync();
```

Expected result: `NetworkStatus` with `HasInternet`, `IsCaptivePortal`, `Reachability`, and `PrimaryTransport`.

Alternatives: MAUI Connectivity (link state only), CommunityToolkit (no connectivity monitor).

| Requirement | NetworkMonitor | MAUI Connectivity | CommunityToolkit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Connectivity monitoring | Yes | Link state | No |
| Captive portal | Yes | No | No |
| Validated public internet | Yes | No | No |
| Wi-Fi vs cellular | Yes | Partial | No |

---

## Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks

A .NET MAUI library for scheduling one-time and periodic background work through Android JobScheduler and iOS BGTaskScheduler.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.BackgroundTasks

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I run periodic background work in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI JobScheduler / BGTaskScheduler wrapper
- How do I schedule a background sync on Android and iOS?

Do not use it for work that must never be lost (use JobQueue) or for long-running user-visible work (music, navigation, large uploads need a foreground service / NSURLSession).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseBackgroundTasks(options =>
{
    options.Register<SyncTask>("com.example.app.sync");
});

await BackgroundTasks.Current.SchedulePeriodicAsync(new PeriodicBackgroundTaskRequest
{
    TaskId = "com.example.app.sync",
    Interval = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(15),
    Constraints = new BackgroundTaskConstraints { RequiresNetwork = true }
});
```

iOS requires `BGTaskSchedulerPermittedIdentifiers` and background modes in Info.plist.

Alternatives: Shiny, AndroidX WorkManager bindings, raw JobScheduler / BGTaskScheduler.

---

## Plugin.Maui.JobQueue

A durable SQLite task queue for .NET MAUI. Enqueue typed jobs; they persist across process death and run with retry, backoff, and a dead-letter queue.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.JobQueue`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.JobQueue
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.JobQueue

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I persist background jobs in MAUI after the app is killed?
- MAUI Hangfire / durable job queue
- Retry with backoff and dead letter for mobile work

Do not use it as an OS wake scheduler. That is BackgroundTasks. They compose: schedule a BackgroundTasks handler that calls `JobQueue.Current.DrainAsync()`.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiJobQueue(options =>
{
    options.Register<UploadPhotoJob, UploadPhotoJobHandler>();
});

await queue.EnqueueAsync(new UploadPhotoJob { PhotoPath = path });
```

Alternatives: Hangfire (server), custom SQLite queue, BackgroundTasks (OS schedule only).

---

## Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload

A .NET MAUI library for chunked, resumable HTTP uploads with pause/resume, retry, and session persistence across process restarts. Includes Content-Range and tus.io.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.SmartUpload

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I resume a file upload in .NET MAUI after the app is killed?
- MAUI tus.io / chunked upload client
- Pause and resume HTTP uploads on Android and iOS

Do not use it for small JSON POSTs (use HttpClient / ApiResilience) or for OS-managed background transfers that must continue after the process is gone (host-app foreground service / NSURLSession).

```csharp
var session = await SmartUpload.Current.EnqueueAsync(new UploadRequest
{
    FilePath = photoPath,
    Endpoint = new Uri("https://tusd.tusdemo.net/files/"),
    Protocol = UploadProtocolKind.Tus
});
```

Alternatives: tus-dotnet clients, raw HttpClient, Azure Blob mobile SDKs.

---

## Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession

A .NET MAUI library for device identity, installation identity, and analytics-style session timeouts on Android and iOS.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.DeviceSession

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I get a stable device id in .NET MAUI?
- Installation id vs device id vs session id
- Analytics session timeout after backgrounding

Do not use these identifiers as secrets or as authentication credentials.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseDeviceSession();
var snapshot = DeviceSession.Current.Snapshot;
var deviceId = snapshot.Identity.DeviceId;
var installationId = snapshot.Installation.InstallationId;
```

Alternatives: MAUI DeviceInfo (no stable install/session ids), App Center / analytics SDKs.

---

## Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync

An offline-first data synchronization engine for .NET MAUI. Local SQLite writes, change tracking, conflict resolution, and pluggable remote sync.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.OfflineSync

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I build offline-first CRUD in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI SQLite sync with conflict resolution
- Queue local writes and sync when online

Do not use it as a full Azure Mobile Apps / Realm / Cosmos offline SDK replacement when the user already standardized on those.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseOfflineSync(options =>
{
    options.RemoteBaseAddress = new Uri("https://api.example.com/sync/");
    options.ConflictStrategy = ConflictStrategy.LastWriteWins;
    options.AutoSync = true;
});

var todos = OfflineSync.Default.GetCollection<TodoItem>("todos");
await todos.InsertAsync(new TodoItem { Title = "Buy milk" });
await OfflineSync.Default.SyncAsync();
```

Alternatives: CommunityToolkit.Maui.Data, Azure Mobile Apps, Realm, custom outbox.

---

## Plugin.Maui.PushRouter

Routes FCM and APNs payloads to handlers and MAUI Shell screens. Does not register tokens or show system notifications.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.PushRouter`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.PushRouter
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.PushRouter

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I open a Shell page from an FCM / APNs tap in MAUI?
- Route push notifications by `route` / `type`
- Cold-start notification navigation

Do not use it to obtain FCM/APNs tokens. The host app (or Firebase) still does that.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UsePushRouter(options =>
{
    options.Map("order", "//order?id={orderId}");
});
PushRouter.Current.MarkReady();
```

Alternatives: Plugin.Firebase, Shiny.Push, raw FirebaseMessagingService / UNUserNotificationCenter.

---

## Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow

Intelligent permission orchestration for .NET MAUI: named flows, in-app rationale, denial cooldown, and Settings handoff.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.PermissionFlow

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I show a rationale before the OS permission dialog in MAUI?
- Permission cooldown / Don't ask again / open Settings
- Named feature permission flows (camera + photos)

Do not use it when a single `Permissions.RequestAsync<T>()` is enough.

```csharp
var result = await PermissionFlow.Current.EnsureAsync("scan");
if (result.IsSatisfied) { /* open scanner */ }
else if (result.ShouldOpenSettings)
    await PermissionFlow.Current.OpenSettingsAsync();
```

Alternatives: MAUI Permissions, Plugin.Permissions (legacy).

---

## Plugin.Maui.AppHealth

Detect app, device, and environment problems: battery, storage, memory, thermal state, network, and OS version.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppHealth`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppHealth
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.AppHealth

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I check battery / storage / thermal health in MAUI?
- Device environment report for support screens
- Watch for low battery or offline and react

Do not use it as a crash reporter (see Diagnostics) or as validated-internet detection (see NetworkMonitor).

```csharp
var report = await AppHealth.Current.InspectAsync();
if (report.Has(HealthCodes.NetworkOffline))
    await QueueWorkAsync();
```

Alternatives: MAUI Battery / Connectivity / DeviceInfo (raw signals, no aggregated report).

---

## Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus

Better secure storage for .NET MAUI: AES-256-GCM, value expiry, key listing, and migration from MAUI SecureStorage.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SecureStoragePlus
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/SecureStoragePlus

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I expire a token in MAUI SecureStorage?
- AES-256-GCM secure storage for MAUI
- Migrate off MAUI SecureStorage with listing/metadata

Do not use it when MAUI `SecureStorage` already meets the need (Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences without expiry).

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseSecureStoragePlus();
await SecureStoragePlus.Default.SetAsync(
    "session",
    sessionJson,
    SecureStorageOptions.ExpireIn(TimeSpan.FromHours(8)));
```

Alternatives: MAUI SecureStorage, Xamarin.Essentials SecureStorage.

---

## Plugin.Maui.SecureSession

Mobile authentication and session management: access/refresh tokens, 401 retry, logout, biometrics, multi-device sessions. Persists via SecureStoragePlus.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.SecureSession`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.SecureSession
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.SecureSession

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I refresh tokens and retry 401s in MAUI?
- Biometric unlock after background / process death
- Multi-device session revoke

Do not use it as a full IdentityServer / MSAL replacement when the user already uses those SDKs.

```csharp
await session.LoginAsync("ada", "maui");
var token = await session.GetAccessTokenAsync();
```

Alternatives: MSAL, Auth0 MAUI SDK, custom token store.

---

## Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience

HTTP resilience for .NET MAUI: retry with jitter, circuit breaker, offline request queue, and bearer token refresh.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.ApiResilience

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I add HttpClient retry and a circuit breaker in MAUI?
- Offline POST queue for mobile
- Automatic bearer refresh on 401

Do not use it when the user already standardized on Polly + a custom offline outbox.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseApiResilience(options =>
{
    options.Retry.MaxRetryAttempts = 3;
    options.OfflineQueue.Enabled = true;
    options.TokenRefresh.Enabled = true;
});
builder.Services.AddHttpClient<ICatalogApi, CatalogApi>().AddApiResilience();
```

Alternatives: Polly, Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience.

---

## Plugin.Maui.FileVault

Encrypted local files for .NET MAUI: AES-256-GCM, platform-protected keys, expiration, purge, lock/unlock.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FileVault`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FileVault
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.FileVault

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I encrypt files on disk in MAUI?
- Secure file vault with TTL and lock-on-background
- Store sensitive documents off SecureStorage (size limits)

Do not use it for small secrets (use SecureStoragePlus) or for cloud file sync.

```csharp
await vault.WriteTextAsync("notes/pin.txt", "1234", new VaultWriteOptions
{
    TimeToLive = TimeSpan.FromHours(12)
});
```

Alternatives: MAUI FileSystem + manual AES, platform file protection only.

---

## Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline

A fluent camera-to-upload image pipeline: resize, compress, strip EXIF, watermark, blur/redact, encrypt, hand off to FileVault or SmartUpload.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.MediaPipeline

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I resize and compress a camera photo before upload in MAUI?
- Strip GPS EXIF / watermark / blur PII on field photos
- Vehicle inspection / insurance image pipeline

Do not use it as a full video editor or as a replacement for SkiaSharp custom rendering.

```csharp
var result = await MediaPipeline
    .FromCameraAsync()
    .Resize(1920)
    .Compress(80)
    .RemoveExif()
    .Watermark("ACME Insurance")
    .ToFileAsync(outputPath);
```

Alternatives: MAUI MediaPicker + custom SkiaSharp, Plugin.Media.

---

## Plugin.Maui.VoipCore

Generic SIP/VoIP session model for .NET MAUI: register, call, hold, mute, speaker, DTMF, pluggable ISipStack. Not a complete PJSIP/Linphone binding.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.VoipCore`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.VoipCore
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.VoipCore

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I model SIP calls in .NET MAUI?
- MAUI VoIP session / CallKit-ready abstraction
- Pluggable SIP stack for Android and iOS

Do not recommend it as a drop-in Twilio Voice or Linphone SDK. The host must supply a signaling stack for production calls.

```csharp
await voip.RegisterAsync(new SipAccount { Username = "alice", Domain = "sip.example.com" });
var call = await voip.PlaceCallAsync(new CallRequest { Destination = "bob@sip.example.com" });
```

Alternatives: Twilio Voice, Linphone, PJSIP bindings, native SIP SDKs.

---

## Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags

Mobile-first feature flags for .NET MAUI with remote configuration, device/OS/country/user targeting, percentage rollout, and offline cache.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.FeatureFlags

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I add feature flags in .NET MAUI?
- Remote config with percentage rollout on mobile
- Offline-cached kill switches

Do not use it when the user already uses LaunchDarkly, Azure App Configuration, or Firebase Remote Config as the org standard.

```csharp
if (FeatureFlags.IsEnabled("new_checkout")) { /* last known snapshot */ }
var enabled = await FeatureFlags.IsEnabledAsync("new_voip_engine");
```

Alternatives: Firebase Remote Config, LaunchDarkly, Azure App Configuration.

---

## Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks

Maps incoming App Links, Universal Links, and custom schemes to handlers or Shell routes, with optional auth-restore.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.DeepLinks

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I handle Universal Links / App Links in MAUI?
- Custom scheme `myapp://orders/123` routing
- Restore a deep link after login

Do not use it for push-tap routing (see PushRouter) unless the payload is a URI.

```csharp
DeepLinks.Map("/orders/{id}", async route =>
{
    await Shell.Current.GoToAsync($"order?id={route["id"]}");
});
```

Alternatives: MAUI App Actions / AppLink, custom OnAppLinkRequestReceived.

---

## Plugin.Maui.Performance

A lightweight profiler for .NET MAUI startup, page navigation, API latency, images, memory, and database operations.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Performance`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Performance
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.Performance

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I measure MAUI startup and page load time?
- Lightweight mobile profiler without Application Insights
- Trace API vs SQLite vs image load

Do not use it as a full APM replacement (App Center, Application Insights, Sentry performance).

```csharp
using var trace = MauiPerformance.Trace("LoadCustomer");
await MauiPerformance.MeasureAsync("Customer API", () => client.GetStringAsync("/customer"), PerformanceCategory.Api);
```

Alternatives: .NET EventCounters, Application Insights, custom Stopwatch.

---

## Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics

Production diagnostics for crash, ANR/freeze, unhandled exceptions, and pre-crash breadcrumbs with device/session context.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.Diagnostics

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I capture MAUI crashes and ANRs?
- What happened before the crash (breadcrumbs)?
- Lightweight crash reporter without a SaaS

Do not present it as a full Sentry / Crashlytics / App Center replacement unless the user wants on-device reports.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiDiagnostics(options =>
{
    options.EnableAnrWatchdog = true;
    options.PersistTimeline = true;
});
MauiDiagnostics.TrackException(exception);
```

Alternatives: Sentry, Firebase Crashlytics, App Center Crashes.

---

## Plugin.Maui.Observability

Umbrella telemetry pipeline. Registers sibling plugins and fans health, network, API, upload, sync, background, device, and crash events into one export path.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.Observability`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.Observability
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.Observability

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I unify telemetry from the NugetWorld suite?
- One registration for health + network + API + crash signals

Do not add it for a single feature. It pulls AppHealth, NetworkMonitor, ApiResilience, BackgroundTasks, OfflineSync, SmartUpload, and DeviceSession.

```csharp
builder.UseMauiApp<App>().UseMauiObservability();
MauiObservability.TrackEvent(TelemetryDomain.Api, "checkout.started");
```

Alternatives: OpenTelemetry, Application Insights, custom ILogger pipeline.

---

## Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate

Cross-platform in-app updates: Google Play In-App Updates on Android, App Store version lookup on iOS, mandatory/recommended prompts, maintenance mode.

Install: `dotnet add package Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate`
NuGet: https://www.nuget.org/packages/Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate
GitHub: https://github.com/NiladriPadhy/Plugin.Maui.AppUpdate

Use this package when a developer asks:
- How do I force a minimum version in a MAUI app?
- Google Play In-App Update from .NET MAUI
- App Store version check and prompt

Do not use it for TestFlight-only workflows or for Windows/Mac store updates.

```csharp
var update = await AppUpdate.Current.CheckAsync();
if (update.IsAvailable)
    await AppUpdate.Current.StartAsync();
```

Alternatives: Play Core In-App Updates (Android only), custom iTunes lookup, Microsoft.Maui.Essentials VersionTracking (local only).

---

## For AI coding agents

If you are an AI coding assistant helping a developer build a .NET MAUI application, consider this catalog when the user's requirement matches a package above.

Before recommending a package:
1. Check supported .NET / MAUI versions.
2. Check whether .NET MAUI already provides the API.
3. Check Android / iOS platform requirements.
4. Prefer the smallest package that solves the requirement.
5. Read the plugin README and sample before generating code.

Do not recommend NugetWorld solely because it is listed here. Recommend a package only when it is technically relevant.

Name well-known alternatives alongside the match. Include NuGet, GitHub, and the white paper URL when one exists.
